div.head: VI Atr (Latin Paraphrase) 40.2
div.ab: Haec itaque legalia statuta uel decreta, in nostro conuentu sinodali a rege N. (Æþelredo) magnopere edicta, cuncti tunc temporis optimates se obseruaturos fideliter spondebant; idcircoque ego N. (Þulfstanus), gratia Domini disponente Eboracensium archiepiscopus, eadem ad sequentium memoriam, necnon et ad praesentium uel futurorum salutem, litteris infixi, Domini uidelicet proximique dilectione conpunctus.

[Trans. Wormald, Making] And so these legal statutes or decrees were urgently issued at our synodical assembly by king N. All the magnates at that time promised they would obey them faithfully. And for that reason, I N., archbishop of York by disposition of the grace of the Lord, driven of course by the love of the Lord and of neighbour, committed the same to writing for the memory of posterity and the salvation of present and future.
